text:
GENERATE BURST CS-objiso-dress-T2 — ISOLATE painted scenery from its own scene crops (Matt fallback, R-C3-61/64/68). task_id "CS-objiso-dress-T2".

IMAGE 1 (1536×1024) is a sheet on flat PURE GREEN #00ff00 holding enlarged crops of a hand-painted 2D ARPG level at sunset (light from the upper-left): ONE living mature tree (trunk, roots, branches and full leafy crown). KEEP ONLY THE TREE. Remove everything else to flat green: ground, grass, shrubs, the wooden CRATES and BARREL beside the trunk, the rocks, pebbles and all ground shadows. Where the removed crates or shrubs hid part of the trunk or roots, paint that part of the trunk complete, matching the tree.
Use image_gen in EDIT mode on IMAGE 1 and deliver ONE 1536×1024 image in which every kept object stays EXACTLY as painted — same pixels, same position in the sheet, same size, outline, colours and lighting (including its own shaded sides, moss or grass growing ON it) — and everything else is flat PURE GREEN #00ff00 with a crisp edge against each object (no halo, no glow, no blur, no green inside leaf gaps that were sky/ground — gaps between leaves and branches become green too). Where an object's base met the ground, finish its bottom edge cleanly. Nothing new is added; nothing moves.

One image_gen call. ONE retry only if a kept object moved, was resized or redrawn differently, ground/shadow/removed objects remain, or the green is not flat — name the reason. Copy the output from $CODEX_HOME/generated_images/... to out/objiso_dress_T2.png with sha256. No code. No other files. No web.
RETURN: receipt task_id "CS-objiso-dress-T2"; images = the file with prompt, references and elapsed_s; calls_used = the TRUE number of image_gen calls; status; concerns. Never PASS/FAIL.
